maria (partnerships): Hey team — want to align on the technical handshake for the Snowflake + Databricks + vector DB connector onboarding for the marketplace listing. Can we confirm required artifacts and integration test matrix?
aj (solutions): +1. Quick list from GTM: listing spec, pricing SKU, quickstart, and 3 integration tests. But we need eng signoff on networking/KMS.
sam (eng-rel): For field trials we also need a lightweight smoke test that runs ingest -> query -> embed comparison. That's what SI partners will run.
leo (product): Timeline ask from marketplace: 2 weeks to get pre-review assets, 6 weeks for cert. Is that still realistic?
rachel (eng): 6 weeks is tight but doable if we avoid full performance tuning in phase 1. Phase 1 should be functional + security + basic perf metrics (p95 latency under X). We'll need a small test harness.
paul (security): Required from our side: network diagram, IP allowlist ranges, KMS attestation notes, and an audit-logging sample. Also confirm whether the connector writes any metadata back to partner endpoints.
maria (partnerships): Great list. Can we map owners: assets (aj), test harness (rachel), security docs (paul), GTM checklist (leo), field trial orchestration (sam)?
aj (solutions): Assigned. I'll draft the quickstart and SKU mapping. Also need a one-click deploy script for partner engineers — prefer Terraform snippets.
rachel (eng): I'll bootstrap a Docker-based harness and a CI job that runs the three smoke scenarios. Minimal config example below:
```yaml
connector_test:
  image: redwood/connector-smoke:latest
  env:
    SNOWFLAKE_URL: $SNOW_URL
    DATABRICKS_HOST: $DBX_HOST
    VECTOR_ENDPOINT: $VECTOR_URL
  steps:
    - ingest: ./scripts/ingest.sh --sample small
    - query: ./scripts/query.sh --similarity 0.8
    - validate: ./scripts/validate_embeddings.py
```
rachel (eng): Will open a PR in infra/tests and link it here when ready. Estimated 4 business days.
paul (security): Note: for KMS we require customer-managed keys for Private listings. Hosted marketplace can use our managed KMS but list that in the policy. Also need retention policy for logs (90d default).
sam (eng-rel): Field trial plan: run with 2 partners (one Snowflake native, one Databricks native) for 3 weeks each. Success criteria: end-to-end ingest, <2% error rate, and acceptable latency for 95% of queries. We'll also collect sample prompts for quality checks.
leo (product): I'll prepare the marketplace pre-review doc and add the SLA expectations. Also flagging that Dedicated customers will want documented autoscale behaviors.
maria (partnerships): Can we confirm network pathing? Do we require a sidecar vs direct connector? This affects SI onboarding complexity.
rachel (eng): Phase 1: sidecar optional. We'll provide both patterns but certify reference install for sidecar (easier for on-prem). Make sure the quickstart covers both.
aj (solutions): I'll make the Terraform example use module-based outputs so partners can plug into their infra.
sam (eng-rel): Also recommend we include an acceptance script partners run post-install. Minimal CLI: `ci/acceptance.sh --endpoint $URL` that returns pass/fail and a log tarball.
paul (security): Add checklist item: secrets storage audit (env vs vault), least-privilege Snowflake role, and Databricks token rotation guidance.
maria (partnerships): Ownership recap + deadlines: aj - quickstart + SKU by 1967001400, rachel - test harness PR by 1967001600, paul - security doc by 1967001500, leo - marketplace pre-review by 1967001500, sam - field trial orchestration plan by 1967001580. Can everyone ack? :point_down:
aj (solutions): Ack. I'll push a branch today. :white_check_mark:
rachel (eng): Ack. Starting work now.
paul (security): Ack. Will drop current template and gaps.
sam (eng-rel): Ack. I'll reach out to partner contacts to schedule trials.
leo (product): Ack. Adding SLA notes.
deploy-bot: CI/status: build queued for infra/tests (PR #134). ETA ~12m.
maria (partnerships): Awesome — I'll consolidate these into a single runbook and link to the shared drive. Quick Q: do we need a partner-facing architecture diagram variant (simplified) plus a deep-dive for SI?
aj (solutions): Yes — two diagrams: one simplified for listing, one detailed for SI. I'll draft both.
leo (product): Also request: sample customer-facing FAQ about data residency and logs to preempt marketplace review questions.
paul (security): I'll add a short blurb for the FAQ about PII handling and the KMS model.
maria (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll create the runbook doc and tag owners. Follow-ups in this thread OK. :rocket:
deploy-bot: CI/status: build passed for infra/tests (PR #134).
